Translation pull request. For anything else, open a normal pull request.

**Language:** <!-- e.g. Romanian (ro) -->

**What changed**
<!-- Corrected wording, finished an unfinished catalog, seeded a new language... -->

**Checks**

- [ ] `tools/lint-i18n.py --locale <code>` passes
- [ ] Keys, placeholders (`%@`, `%ld`, `%1$@`), and escapes are untouched
- [ ] Entries stay in alphabetical order
- [ ] Numbered footers still have one line per row in their section
- [ ] Plural forms use the categories this language actually requires

**Reviewed as a speaker of this language**

- [ ] I read every string I changed and it reads naturally
- [ ] I read the whole catalog end to end <!-- tick only if true: this is what qualifies a language to ship with Sparkle -->

**Tested on device** *(optional but useful)*
<!-- Installed as a language pack and checked settings, alerts, menus, dates. RTL languages: also layout direction. -->

**Credit**

- [ ] Credit me in README.md and the in-app About page
